messages:
maya: FYI, nightly INT8 run flagged a weird spike on summarization prompts — lots of repetition and ROUGE drop. Pasting eval summary below.

eval-bot: NIGHTLY-EVAL 2026-03-20 02:13 UTC for model=mistral-ish-7b quant=int8_profile_v3
  metrics: rouge-L -7.3, rouge-1 -5.1, repetition_rate +18% (vs baseline fp16)
  failing_prompts: 412/5000 (8.2%) flagged as low-quality/gibberish
  sample_bad_output: "Summary: The experiment shows that the the result is is is repeated multiple times."

maya: repro snippet I used:
```bash
./tools/run_eval --model mistral-ish-7b --quant profile=int8_profile_v3 --calib=per_channel --dataset summarization-nightly --seed 42 --batch 8
```

arjun: can you paste the exact quant config? also which hw (A100/H100)?

maya: config below. hw=A100-80GB in CI pool.
```yaml
quant: int8_symmetric
calibration: per_channel
clip_scale: 2.5
act_stats_buffer: 2048
use_kv_sharing: true
```

koji: :eyes: quick note — we recently changed KV cache memcpy behavior in the runtime (PR #5421). If KV pointers aren't zeroed after quant path switch, you can get stale tokens repeating. Not saying it's definitely that, but repetition + int-path flip = suspicious.

serena: does the nightly use the same calib dataset as onboarding? sometimes mismatch between calib set and eval prompts surfaces this.

maya: nightly calibration uses the 'calib-default' pool (500 random doc windows). onboarding uses 'calib-longform' for this model. could be related.

ci-bot: CI ALERT: merge 2026-03-19 23:01 changed quant/clip_scale default from 2.0 -> 2.5 (commit abc123). Affected: int8_profile_v3.

arjun: ok this is looking like two contenders: (1) clip_scale change making activations clip differently -> distribution shift; (2) KV cache memcpy bug when switching execution path. we should triage quickly.

koji: plan I propose:
- run repro on H100 to rule out hw-specific kernel fallback (maya)
- run with old clip_scale=2.0 to see if metric improves (arjun)
- reproduce with kv zeroing patch locally to test stale token hypothesis (koji)
- run calib using 'calib-longform' instead of calib-default for comparison (serena)

maya: starting H100 run now (kicking off with --batch 1, shorter seqs). will post logs.

arjun: starting automated run patching clip_scale->2.0 and metrics mirror on my machine. will run full 5k prompts, ETA ~22m.

koji: local test with memzero patch — quick smoke shows repetition reduced in ~20/50 samples. need full run but promising.

serena: I'll re-run calibration with 'calib-longform' and produce quant scales. if scale distributions diverge a lot from 'calib-default' that's a smoking gun.

maya: posted H100 log excerpt:
```
[run] model=mistral-ish-7b quant=int8_profile_v3 hw=h100-80gb
[eval] prompt_id=338 sample_out="Summary: The experiment shows the result."
[metrics] rouge-L delta vs fp16: -0.9
```

maya: H100 looks much better in quick pass (rouge drop negligible).

arjun: my clip_scale rollback run finished: rouge-L delta now -1.2, repetition_rate +2%. big improvement.

koji: full memzero run (50/5000 so far) lgtm, repetition down dramatically.

serena: calib-longform vs calib-default scales: averaging per-channel scale differs by ~12% on the top-10 most-activated channels. calib-default had heavier tail (higher scales).

maya: summary/action items:
- immediate: pin int8_profile_v3 clip_scale to 2.0 in nightly until we confirm (arjun) :lock:
- short-term: land runtime memzero fix + add fuzz test around kv-path switches (koji) :bug:
- investigate calibration set mismatch; consider switching nightly to calib-longform for this model (serena)
- verify H100/A100 parity in kernels and add matrix test to CI for quantized path (maya)

arjun: I'll open a rollback PR for clip_scale and add a canary job.

koji: working on memzero PR, will include perf numbers.

serena: will run full calib set diff and upload scales.csv to the triage thread.

maya: thanks all. leaving this thread open while we run full 5k jobs. please post short updates here. :thumbsup:

arjun: running -> 5k done, metrics stable with clip_scale=2.0. pushing rollback PR.

koji: memzero PR up for review. basic tests pass, e2e running.

serena: uploaded scales.csv (link: https://internal/s3/triage/1801234567/scales.csv). differences look consistent with hypothesis.

maya: closing loop: will mark nightly as transient regression; rollback applied and runtime fix queued. follow-ups for calibration policy and CI matrix in product/eng planning. thanks. :white_check_mark:
